title: שמעון הצנוע

paragraphs: Shimon the Modest said before R' Eliezer—Be'er Sheva on Tamid writes “before R' Meir,” which requires examination, since R' Meir lived after the destruction—“I entered between the vestibule and the altar without washing my hands and feet”: Tosafot, Yoma 5b; Tosefta Kelim, first chapter. R' Eliezer said to him, “Even the high priest's dog is more beloved than you.”
